answer_1.quote: Confidence estimation has become increasingly critical with the widespread deployment of deep neural networks in practice . It aims to measure the model's confidence in the prediction, showing when it probably fails... neural machine translation (NMT) is reported to yield poor-calibrated confidence estimate... We aim to learn the confidence estimate jointly with the training process in an unsupervised manner...

answer_2.quote: We use the 4-gram BLEU to score the performance... We evaluate the performance of QE in terms of Pearson's correlation with DA scores... We assess the performance of failure prediction with standard metrics...

answer_4.quote: Each translation is annotated with direct assessment (DA) by professional translators... Two graduate students are asked to annotate each target word as either OK or BAD...
answer_4.guideline: DA: perceived translation quality on a scale of 0-100; word-level: annotate as OK or BAD for definite mistakes
